101.manual_summary: The first optical load sensor on the mast reports an implausible signal when manual lifting mode is active. Load detection cannot be reliably validated.
actions_summary: Inspect optical load sensor 1 alignment and cleanliness
Check wiring and connectors for damage
Verify correct manual lifting mode selection

102.manual_summary: The second optical load sensor provides inconsistent feedback during manual lifting mode, preventing reliable load evaluation.
actions_summary: Inspect optical load sensor 2 mounting and condition

103.manual_summary: The start command remains active for an extended time while automatic lifting is selected, indicating an abnormal input condition.
actions_summary: Inspect input wiring for short circuits

110.manual_summary: A malfunction has been detected in brake control or brake adjustment. Safe braking performance may be affected.

111.manual_summary: The measured resistance of the brake coil is below the acceptable range, suggesting a short circuit or internal fault.

112.manual_summary: The brake coil resistance exceeds the permissible range, indicating a possible open circuit or coil degradation.

113.manual_summary: Brake coil current is insufficient to ensure proper brake release or holding function.

115.manual_summary: The truck is detected in wheel change mode, which restricts normal driving and lifting functions.
actions_summary: Exit wheel change mode if not required
Check service mode switch or configuration

116.manual_summary: The mast position potentiometer is active while optical load sensor signals are inconsistent. Mast position and load data cannot be correlated.

117.manual_summary: The system has entered reduced battery mode because the current demand exceeds the battery’s supply capability.
actions_summary: Inspect load conditions and power demand
Recharge or replace battery if required

118.manual_summary: The battery state of charge has reached the first low threshold. Initial performance limitations may occur.

119.manual_summary: The battery state of charge has reached the second low threshold, leading to further functional restrictions.

120.manual_summary: The pre-charging process of the power electronics did not complete successfully during startup.

121.manual_summary: The battery state of charge has reached a critical low level. Operation may be heavily restricted.

122.manual_summary: The Li-ion battery reports an abnormal internal state that affects availability or performance.

127.manual_summary: The butterfly control was rotated for an extended time while the tiller was in the rest position, indicating an implausible operator input.
actions_summary: Return butterfly control to neutral position

131.manual_summary: An internal control error has been detected. Additional active error codes are required for root cause analysis.

137.manual_summary: Traction and lift performance are limited to reduce current consumption due to Li-ion battery constraints. Lifting may be disabled under high load.

140.manual_summary: The combined voltage of accelerator signals exceeds the permitted tolerance, indicating an implausible input.

152.manual_summary: The CRC data value received by the safety system is invalid, indicating corrupted or incorrect safety data.

155.manual_summary: Safety CAN messages are not being received within the expected time frame.
actions_summary: Verify power supply to safety modules

156.manual_summary: Received safety CAN messages contain invalid values that cannot be interpreted correctly.

157.manual_summary: The CRC of received safety CAN messages is invalid, indicating data corruption.
actions_summary: Inspect CAN bus wiring and shielding

158.manual_summary: The counter value of safety CAN messages is invalid, indicating synchronization issues.

167.manual_summary: A general battery warning indicates abnormal battery-related conditions.

200.manual_summary: Safety CAN communication with the MMI unit is missing or disturbed.
actions_summary: Check MMI and controller power supply

245.manual_summary: The traction motor temperature exceeds the permissible limit, activating thermal protection.

330.manual_summary: A permanent fault is detected in the driver circuits of the power transistors.

400.manual_summary: The safety self-test failed because the safety relay remained energized when a shutdown was requested.

401.manual_summary: The safety self-test failed because a contactor remained closed when it should have opened.

407.manual_summary: The sensor supply voltage is outside the permissible operating range, resulting in invalid sensor readings.

443.manual_summary: The tiller is in working position and the belly switch is activated, but the truck does not move as expected.
